title: A worker proves a failing reproduction test before its fix and ends on green
body:
Why: Agentless reproduction+regression selection 25.67 -> 32.0; TestPrune +4.8 pp; R2E-Gym verifier 42.9 -> 51.0 (papers.md). A red test, not tracker state, defines done.
Outcome: the worker brief/flow requires a red test named before the fix (or an existing red hidden-in-repo test), and the final report shows it green; measured as an arm on D23 v2.
Proof: D23 v2 arm K+test-first vs K.
Scope: src/, evals/d23/, test/.
Amendment A4 (fable-plan 2.3, AR:247): after t-kmsa30s, measured as one arm.
